• 交替用药：同种农药连续使用易产生抗药性，建议2-3种交替: • Alternate products: repeated use of the same pesticide builds resistance; alternate 2–3 types
• 休眠期修剪：落叶后至萌芽前（冬季）进行，修剪量可较大: • Dormant pruning: after leaf drop and before budding (winter), with heavier cuts allowed

• 草屑处理：少量草屑可留作覆盖，过多需清理防病害: • Clippings: leave a little as mulch; clear excess to prevent disease
